subject: Request: short-window quota uplift + retro billing options
messages:
From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@acme.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@platformco.com>
Date: Sat, 13 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Urgent: 72-hr quota uplift request + how will retro billing work?

Hi Kimberly,

Quick one — our product team just confirmed a 72-hour promotional window next Monday–Wednesday that will spike inference volume for two of our consumer flows. We expect peak generation of roughly 2.2M tokens/hour (short sequences) for ~48 hours within the 72-hr window. Our current committed capacity will be exhausted within the first day.

Can Redwood do a short-window quota augmentation? We need to understand the billing options:
- Can you provision a temporary uplift that we pay for at the same committed rate, and then true-up on the next invoice?
- Alternatively, do you offer one-time burst credits or a flat overrun rate for such events?
- If neither, what would the pro-rated charges look like and how fast can this be activated (we may need it within 24 hours)?

We have a signed enterprise MSA and a PO in place (PO# 98021). If there is an amendment or rider to sign, we can expedite. We are also open to a capped overrun with daily limits if that helps reduce cost uncertainty.

Please let us know options and approximate prices (ballpark is fine) so I can share with engineering and finance.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Alex
Alex Moreno
Head of Platform Ops | Acme AI
alex.moreno@acme.ai | +1 415-555-0199

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 13 Nov 2027 11:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: 72-hr quota uplift request + how will retro billing work?

Alex — thanks for the heads-up and the estimates.

We can support short-window uplifts; below are three practical paths depending on your preference for speed vs price certainty:

Option A — Provisional uplift with committed-rate true-up (recommended if you want lowest unit price):
- We provision the requested extra capacity immediately (same per-token price as your committed plan).
- We will track the extra usage and apply a true-up on your next invoice (line item: "Provisional uplift true-up").
- Requires a quick signed amendment (DocuSign) confirming the uplift window; we can pre-fill and e-sign in a few hours.

Option B — Burst credit / one-time bucket (fastest activation, limited scale):
- We apply a one-time burst credit that covers X tokens (you prepay or we invoice) at a slightly higher unit price than committed, but no retro true-up complexity.
- Useful if you want to cap exposure.

Option C — Temporary rate with daily cap (best for predictable exposure):
- We raise your rates to an agreed overrun rate but enforce a daily token cap. Overrun beyond the cap will be blocked.
- No amendment required if within the existing overrun clause, but finance must confirm the rate.

I attached a short pricing sketch (provisional_uplift_pricing.pdf) with ballpark unit prices by option and an example calculation using a 2.2M tokens/hr peak. Please review and tell us which option you prefer.

Quick questions for sizing final pricing:
- Confirm the expected peak window in UTC (start/end).
- Confirm whether requests are short sequences (you said short — helpful for caching/batching impact).
- Do you want Redwood to enforce a soft cap (notify + allow) or a hard cap (block) if you hit an agreed daily limit?

If you like, Ben and I can join a 30-min call this afternoon to finalize. If fast activation is required we can do A with a post-event amendment.

— Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0123

Attachments: provisional_uplift_pricing.pdf (pricing sketch), SOW_overrun_calculation.xlsx (template)

Kimberly — thanks, Option A sounds like the simplest from our side (lowest unit cost and we can handle post-event reconciliation). A few clarifications:

1) Peak window (UTC): Nov 15 14:00 UTC — Nov 17 14:00 UTC (roughly 48 hours of sustained peak within that window).
2) Sequences are ~15 tokens average; majority are short generations.
3) We prefer a soft cap: please notify at 90% and again at 100%, but allow traffic to continue — we will be responsible for the overrun.

On pricing, the provisional_pricing PDF looks reasonable. We will accept the true-up approach at the committed rate, provided Redwood can guarantee activation within 8 hours of confirmation. Can you confirm activation SLAs? Also please confirm you will roll the true-up into our standard monthly invoice (so our AP doesn't get a separate charge).

Jordan, looping you in for PO/finance confirmation.

— Alex
